notes.title: COMMUNITY ITEMS ARE NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Now you can customize your Steam profile with items from Irmão do Jorel. We’re excited to show you the new items available, and if you’ve already played the game, you’ll receive the cards retroactively!

[h2]Steam Trading Cards[/h2]
[i]Jorel's Brother and the most Important Game of the Galaxy[/i] now has [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b], which you can unlock by playing the game over time. These cards are tradable and can be used to unlock special Irmão do Jorel badges, emojis (for use in the Steam chat system), and profile backgrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/951a85e5eb1c41e6d748f6a65d366f1bd745168f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/6b8afbac1a6dca85521471d6a51c70e97f0dd6fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/c2158f3de6ca56d6651784f947c51c7cad132ebd.png[/img]


[h2]Steam Badges[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/24518353dd8fc929c532e7abb3c24e6022aa88cf.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Emojis[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/80ae37386c8758f3afa0eaa6d57ea3041e8103a2.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy this new feature! Thank you for playing the most important game in the galaxy!

notes.title: Bugfixes and Minor Improvements - June 03, 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Guys![/h2]

Thank you very much for all the feedback you sent to improve the game! We've made some improvements, and we're also aware of issues we're working to fix!

[list][h3]Language Selection Flow[/h3]
[*]We have simplified the language selection process, making it easier and more intuitive.

[h3]General Adjustments and Fixes[/h3]
[*]We made minor adjustments and fixes to improve the app's performance and stability.

[h3]Control Indication Improvements[/h3]
[*]Control indications are now clearer and more precise, making navigation easier.

[h3]Age Selection Screen[/h3]
[*]We have now included a new screen to select your age, ensuring a more personalized experience.
[/list]

Please feel free to send us feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1398910/discussions/] Steam forum[/url] by logging into our[url=https://discord.gg/doubledashstu ] Discord [/url]or message us at support@doubledashstudios.com.

Thanks again for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/6041bfc176c37a11c0ad7db6902e00ca04dbb0b3.png[/img]

notes.title: THE FULL VERSION IS AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/6a1ffa2282dcb150dff98ad79d0c761266552e75.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Full Version is Available! [/h2]

The Complete Edition of the Most Important Game of the Galaxy, with all DLCs included:
[list]
[*][b]Chapter 2[/b] - The Lustrous of the Universe
[*][b]Chapter 3[/b] - The Final Rave
[/list]
Those who bought only the first chapter will receive the Complete Edition update for free, with all the content. And those who don't have the game yet, can purchase the Complete Edition normally, with all these contents!

The Complete Edition also marks the arrival of Jorel's Brother and the most Important Game of the Galaxy for consoles, today we also release it for[b] Xbox [/b]and [b]Nintendo Switch![/b]

Check out the new launch trailer for this new version!

[previewyoutube=sAISeLioV08;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for supporting us on this journey! We are working on more news from this universe, so keep following us! Or join our [b]Discord[/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/doubledashstu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/96ad8af4ec96070dd0aef5e0b88a7845d7523531.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: You can PLAY NOW Jorel's Brother and the Greatest Game in the Galaxy!
notes.content:
[h1]THE MOST IMPORTANT LAUNCH IN THE GALAXY?![/h1]

Today we are very happy to announce that the game is finally available for purchase.

But can't you play everything at once? 🤔
 
Calm down, we'll explain: We've separated the game into three chapters, which will be released at intervals of two months until October! Until then, we want to bring the game to more platforms! So enjoy and don't forget to leave a review on the Steam page! 🥰❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42493353/81e6b2bc4409424efd46ec9b6a99ca45417d5538.gif[/img]
